title: Large Data Volumes: Report Timeouts on an 18M-Row Object

steps.prompt: Transaction__c holds 18 million rows split evenly across 6 values of Region__c. Analysts review only the current quarter, about 600,000 rows, but their reports filter on Region__c and time out. The Query Plan Tool shows a table scan. What should the architect change?

options.label: Add a current-quarter CreatedDate range to the report filters
options.rationale: Selective queries filter first on an indexed field so the optimizer can use the index instead of scanning. CreatedDate carries a standard index, and a 600,000-row quarter stays under the 1 million row ceiling for standard indexes, while each region matches 3 million rows.

options.label: Request a custom index on Region__c from Salesforce Support
options.rationale: On an 18 million row object a custom index is used only when the filter matches fewer than 333,333 rows, and each region matches 3 million, so the optimizer still scans.

options.label: Request a skinny table that holds Region__c and the report columns
options.rationale: A skinny table removes the join between standard and custom field storage, but a Region__c filter matching 3 million rows stays non-selective, so the report still scans 18 million rows.
